story.titleZh: 沃尔夫指责维斯塔潘致拉塞尔失去意大利大奖赛杆位
story.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队老板托托·沃尔夫声称，乔治·拉塞尔在意大利大奖赛排位赛最后阶段受马克斯·维斯塔潘影响而错失杆位，杆位最终由阿尔派的皮埃尔·加斯利爆冷夺得。
story.originalTitle: Mercedes boss Toto Wolff blames Max Verstappen for George Russell missing out on Italian GP pole to Pierre Gasly
story.summaryEn: Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff claims George Russell's final qualifying lap at the Italian Grand Prix was compromised by Max Verstappen, with the pole position ultimately going to Pierre Gasly in a shock result for Alpine.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫指责马克斯·维斯塔潘，称其导致乔治·拉塞尔在意大利大奖赛排位赛中错失杆位，杆位最终被皮埃尔·加斯利夺得
乔治·拉塞尔与杆位失之交臂，皮埃尔·加斯利为阿尔派车队爆冷取得杆位；拉塞尔的最后一个排位赛飞驰圈似乎受到了马克斯·维斯塔潘的影响；请于周日下午2点通过天空体育 F1观看意大利大奖赛直播，中午12点30分开始赛前节目
2026年意大利大奖赛排位赛精华
梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫声称，乔治·拉塞尔在意大利大奖赛错失杆位，是因为在蒙扎排位赛的尾声阶段被马克斯·维斯塔潘"坑了一把"。
拉塞尔原本有望不负杆位热门的名号，但他最后一个飞驰圈受到了影响——红牛车队的维斯塔潘以及他的梅赛德斯队友基米·安东内利在他前方减速。
梅赛德斯让积分榜领跑者安东内利在赛道上跑在拉塞尔前面，为这位英国车手提供尾流拖拽，原因是这位意大利车手因本赛季超出引擎部件使用配额将受罚，无论排位成绩如何都将从队尾发车。

拉塞尔仍然提升了自己的成绩并做出最快圈速，但随后杆位惊人地被阿尔派的皮埃尔·加斯利夺走，加斯利上演了这项运动历史上最大的排位赛冷门之一。
皮埃尔·加斯利为 阿尔派 拿下了 17 年来的首个杆位！
当被 天空体育 F1 问及拉塞尔错失杆位是否出了什么问题时，沃尔夫说：“是的，我认为是在最后一节，他在起步飞驰圈时被马克斯干扰了。
“当时距离实在太近了，这最终影响了他的单圈成绩，也因此丢掉了杆位。”
在蒙扎，获得前方赛车的尾流对做出单圈速度至关重要，维斯塔潘（Verstappen）在失去与前方迈凯伦赛车的联系后，试图强迫另一辆赛车跑到自己前面。
当维斯塔潘在最后一个弯道前减速时，安东内利（Antonelli）超过了这辆红牛，而拉塞尔（Russell）则紧跟在他们身后。
虽然尾流很有用，但整圈都离前车太近也会对性能产生负面影响，拉塞尔认为情况正是如此。
梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔谈到在意大利大奖赛排位赛中以微弱差距错失杆位、不敌皮埃尔·加斯利的反应
"我们在进圈时和维斯塔潘有点乱，"拉塞尔说。"他想要跟车拖曳，基米也在那里，而我在马克斯后面一秒半做圈速，这并不理想。"
当被问到梅赛德斯是否本可以采取不同做法来避免这种情况时，拉塞尔回答："我认为不能，一切本来都很顺利，但进入帕拉博利卡弯时，马克斯突然猛踩刹车，他不想当领头车。"
"所以，这就是那种没办法的事。你无法控制别人做什么。基米本来是要给我尾流的，第一次飞驰圈他做得非常完美，但显然有马克斯在，我觉得这也让基米很难知道自己该怎么办。"
"所以，这只是一点小小的遗憾。事后来看，也许不去尝试会更好，但我们想全力以赴。"
皮埃尔·加斯利对在意大利大奖赛上出人意料地获得首个杆位作出反应
尽管因错失杆位而感到沮丧，拉塞尔仍有很大机会缩小他与积分榜榜首安东内利之间59分的差距。
他告诉天空体育F1频道：“我感觉很好。我认为关键就是有一个干净的发车，干净的第一圈。
“只要在前几圈之后我还能排在前三或前四，你就仍然有很大机会去争夺胜利。这就是目标。”
维斯塔潘：我的车像袋鼠一样跳
维斯塔潘在排位赛后没有谈及最后弯角的事件，但他透露他自己赛车的速度已经因赛车受损而受到影响，导致赛车“像袋鼠一样跳”。
"我一出去跑排位赛，赛车上又有什么东西出故障了,"维斯塔潘对天空体育F1表示。
"这个问题我们是知道的，今年已经发生过好几次了，但它在低速路段就是很损失圈速，赛车跳动得比应该的程度厉害得多。在颠簸路面上、在路肩上，赛车已经不再有好的顺应性了。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里因阻挡劳森被处以退后三位发车的处罚！
“实际上我对第三次自由练习赛中的赛车非常满意，因为我们相比昨天向前迈进了一大步。赛车处在一个好得多的工作窗口，总的来说我认为今天它处在一个好得多的窗口，总的来说我认为今天它处在一个好得多的窗口。
“但是当赛车没有良好的行驶控制、像袋鼠一样到处乱跳时，你就无法保持稳定。没能发挥出我们的最佳表现，确实有些遗憾。
这位四届世界冠军在排位赛中排名第六，但由于皮亚斯特里因阻挡他人被处以发车位处罚，他将上升一位至第五位发车。
谈到正赛的前景，他补充道：“我们必须能够更换出问题的那个部件，否则以这样的状态比赛将会非常艰难。”
detailEn: Mercedes boss Toto Wolff blames Max Verstappen for George Russell missing out on Italian GP pole to Pierre Gasly

George Russell missed out on pole as Pierre Gasly claimed a shock result for Alpine; Russell's final qualifying lap appeared to be compromised by Max Verstappen; watch the Italian Grand Prix live on Sunday at 2pm on Sky Sports F1, with build-up from 12.30pm
Highlights from qualifying for the 2026 Italian Grand Prix

Mercedes boss Toto Wolff has claimed that George Russell missed out on pole position for the Italian Grand Prix because he "got done over" by Max Verstappen during the closing stages of qualifying at Monza.

Russell appeared to be on course to live up to his status as pole favourite, but his final flying lap was compromised by Red Bull's Verstappen slowing down in front of him and his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli.

Mercedes had placed championship leader Antonelli on track in front of Russell to give the Brit a tow, due to the fact the Italian is serving penalties for exceeding his engine-part allowance for the season and was going to start the race from the back of the grid regardless of his qualifying position.

Russell still improved his time to go fastest but then had pole remarkably snatched away from him by Alpine's Pierre Gasly, who pulled off one of the biggest qualifying shocks in the sport's history.
Pierre Gasly claims Alpine's first pole in 17 years!
Asked by Sky Sports F1 whether something had gone wrong for Russell to miss out on pole, Wolff said: "Yeah, I think at the end where he got done over by Max in the final run when launching the lap.
"It was just much too close, and that compromised the lap time eventually and that lost pole position."
With having a tow from the car in front being crucial to delivering a fast lap at Monza, Verstappen sought to force another car in front after having lost touch with the McLarens ahead of him.
As Verstappen slowed down ahead of the final corner, Antonelli passed the Red Bull, while Russell remained just behind them.
While a tow is useful, being too close to the car in front for the entire lap can also have a negative impact on performance, which Russell felt was the case.
Mercedes driver George Russell reacts to narrowly missing out on pole position to Pierre Gasly during qualifying at the Italian Grand Prix
"We had a bit of a mess with Verstappen entering the lap," Russell said. "He wanted to go for the tow, Kimi was there as well, and I did my lap a second and a half behind Max, which wasn't ideal.

Asked whether Mercedes could have done anything differently to avoid the situation, Russell replied: "I think, no, everything was all looking fine, but then going into Parabolica, Max just slammed on the brakes, and he didn't want to be the lead car.

"So, it's just one of those things. You can't control what other people do. Kimi was there to give me the slipstream, which he did perfectly on the first run, but obviously with Max, I think it also made it difficult for Kimi to know what to do as well.
"So, it was just a little bit unfortunate. In hindsight, probably would have been better off not trying this, but we wanted to give it everything."
Pierre Gasly reacts to a shock first pole position at Italian GP
Despite his frustration at missing out on pole, Russell remains in with a strong chance of reducing his 59-point deficit to Antonelli at the top of the standings.
He told Sky Sports F1: "I'm feeling good. I think the key is just to have a clean start, a clean first lap.
"As long as I'm in the top three or four after the first few laps, you're still within a great shot to fight for victory. That's the goal."
Verstappen: My car was jumping like a kangaroo
Verstappen didn't address the final-corner incident after qualifying, but revealed his own pace had been compromised by damage to his car, causing it to jump "like a kangaroo".
"As soon as I went out for qualifying, something failed again on the car," Verstappen told Sky Sports F1.

"It's something that we are aware of, and it happens more often in the year, but it's just costing lap time in the low-speed where the car just starts jumping around a lot more than it should do. On the bumps, the kerbs, the car's not compliant anymore.
Oscar Piastri is given a three-grid place penalty for this Lawson block!

"I was actually very happy with the car in FP3 because we took a big step forward from yesterday. The car was in a much better window, and overall I think today it was in a much better window, and overall I think today it was in a much better window.
"But when you have no ride control and the car is just jumping around like a kangaroo, you can't be consistent. It's actually a bit of a shame to not optimise our performance.
The four-time world champion qualified sixth but will move up a place to fifth on the grid due to Oscar Piastri being given a grid penalty for impeding.
On his prospects for the race, he added: "We need to be able to change whatever the part is, because otherwise it's going to be quite tough to race like that."

detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿：法拉利车队的七届F1世界冠军在访问拉法口岸后，呼吁以色列“放行援助卡车”进入加沙。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿周二访问了拉法口岸，实地了解向加沙运送援助物资的工作；这位法拉利车手周三在Instagram发帖，呼吁以色列“履行停火协议下的义务”。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在访问拉法口岸后，呼吁以色列“放行援助卡车”进入加沙。
汉密尔顿周二在埃及，实地了解向加沙运送人道主义与救援物资的工作。这位法拉利车手还参观了拉法口岸，并走访了埃及红新月会的援助仓库。
美国支持的以色列与哈马斯之间的停火协议仍然有效，但并未结束以色列对加沙的打击，同时联合国世界粮食计划署表示，加沙三分之二的人口难以获得足够的食物。
汉密尔顿此前曾呼吁该地区实现和平，他表示援助物资因“疯狂的理由”被拒绝进入加沙。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿（@lewishamilton）分享的一条帖子。
您可以随时通过隐私选项更改您的设置。
这位七届世界冠军在Instagram上发文称：“过去三年以色列在加沙的种族灭绝行径令人震惊。”
“人们被剥夺自由、安全和尊严，这是不公正的。任何人都不应被当作生命不那么重要来对待。”
“我看到绵延数英里的围墙，是为了把他们困在里面而建的。站在外面，感觉就像一座露天监狱，我满脑子想的都是进去帮忙。”
“在拉法口岸，我看到食品卡车排着队准备出发，但它们经常不被允许进入，或者面临严重延误。我交谈过的排在第一位的那位司机已经等了超过12个小时。”
在附近的物流中心，我看到了救援人员的辛勤工作，但我也看到了因荒唐理由被拒绝的物资。睡袋、急救包、医疗设备、轮椅，甚至给孩子们的足球。
以色列需要履行停火协议下的义务，让援助卡车进入。没有任何借口。
我知道很多人都感受到同样的无助。同样觉得需要做点什么，而不是袖手旁观。我不想让我们对他们的苦难习以为常。我不想让我们移开视线。
周三，以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡否认以色列在拖延物资进入加沙，并将加沙不断恶化的状况归咎于哈马斯，指责他们拒绝解除武装并截留援助物资用于军事用途。
2021年，汉密尔顿创立了Mission 44慈善机构，旨在支持年轻人并改善他们获得教育和就业机会的途径。
他还支持了人道主义和救援倡议，以及为受冲突影响的人们提供帮助的努力。
汉密尔顿是在上周末参加圣保罗大奖赛并获得第九名后进行了此次访问。他接下来将代表法拉利参加拉斯维加斯大奖赛，第一次练习赛于11月20日星期五举行。
汉密尔顿分享了与加沙儿童会面的细节
在首次发帖一天后，汉密尔顿于周四再次通过社交媒体分享了他与从加沙撤离的儿童互动的细节。
除了分享一组自己与孩子们的合影外，汉密尔顿写道：“在埃及见到一些由@inaraorg支持的从加沙撤离的巴勒斯坦儿童，我的心都碎了。
“这些美丽、聪明的孩子经历了创伤、悲痛和可怕的伤害，这些是任何孩子都不应该承受的事情。有些孩子在袭击中中弹或严重烧伤，仍在面对复杂的康复之路。但真正打动我的是他们如此坚韧，而且似乎在彼此身上找到了许多快乐。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿（@lewishamilton）分享的帖子

“当我问起他们的梦想时，他们谈到想成为老师和医生，这样就能像曾经帮助过他们的人那样去帮助别人。在经历了这一切之后，他们仍然想象着一个关爱他人的未来。这让我一直难以忘怀。
“我在学校、医院和一家心理健康诊所遇到了孩子们，帮助他们走出创伤。我还走进了一些家庭，倾听他们关于康复以及与亲人——他们的孩子、父母、兄弟姐妹——分离的故事。那种分离和不确定带来的痛苦令人难以理解。
“他们的故事让我想到了仍留在加沙的孩子们，他们生活在恶劣的条件下。据报道，自2023年10月以来，已有超过21500名儿童丧生，45000人受伤。他们每一个人都曾有过一个家和一个未来。我们不能忘记他们。
“这些孩子和你们的孩子没有不同。他们的生命同样珍贵。他们本应能在教室里与朋友相伴感到安全，与家人在一起，并憧憬未来。我非常感激我遇到的年轻人正在获得他们所需的帮助，但他们不得不离开家园去寻找安全，这令人心碎。”
加沙卫生当局表示，自2023年10月以色列开始对加沙发动攻势以来，已有超过74000人丧生。
以色列是在哈马斯武装人员对以色列南部发动袭击后发起这次攻势的，以方称该袭击造成约1200人死亡。

detailEn: Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari's seven-time F1 world champion urges Israel to 'let the aid trucks in' to Gaza after visit to Rafah border

Lewis Hamilton visited the Rafah border on Tuesday to witness efforts to transport aid into Gaza; Ferrari driver published Instagram post on Wednesday calling on Israel to "fulfil its obligations under the ceasefire"
Lewis Hamilton urged Israel to "let the aid trucks in" to Gaza after visiting the Rafah border.

Hamilton was in Egypt on Tuesday to witness efforts to deliver humanitarian and relief aid bound for Gaza. The Ferrari driver also toured the Rafah border crossing and visited the Egyptian Red Crescent's aid warehouses.

The US-backed ceasefire between Israel and Hamas remains in place but has not ended Israeli strikes on Gaza, while the UN World Food Programme says two-thirds of Gaza's population are struggling to get enough to eat.
Hamilton - who has previously called for peace in the region - said aid was being denied entry into Gaza for "crazy reasons".

The seven-time world champion posted on Instagram: "The past three years of Israel's genocide in Gaza is appalling.
"It's an injustice for people to be denied their freedom, their safety and their dignity. No human being should be treated as though their life matters less.
"I saw walls stretching for miles, built to keep them in. Standing there, outside what felt like an open-air prison, all I could think about was getting in to help.
"At Rafah border, I saw food trucks lined up ready to go, but they're regularly not allowed in or face major delays. The first driver in line that I spoke to had already been waiting over 12 hours.

"At the nearby logistics centre, I saw the hard work of the aid workers, but I also saw what gets rejected for crazy reasons. Sleeping bags, first-aid kits, medical equipment, wheelchairs, even footballs for kids.
"Israel needs to fulfil its obligations under the ceasefire and let the aid trucks in. No excuse.
"I know so many people feel that same helplessness. That same need to do something rather than just watch. I don't want us to get used to their suffering. I don't want us to look away."

On Wednesday, Benjamin Netanyahu, the Israeli Prime Minister, denied Israel was delaying the entry of supplies into Gaza, and blamed Hamas for the worsening conditions in Gaza, accusing them of a refusal to disarm and seizing aid for military use.
In 2021, Hamilton founded Mission 44, a charity aimed at supporting young people and improving ⁠access to education and employment ​opportunities.
He has also backed ​humanitarian and relief initiatives, and ​efforts to support people affected by ⁠conflict.
Hamilton made his visit after competing in the Sao Paulo GP last weekend, where he finished ninth. He will next compete for Ferrari in the Las Vegas GP, with Practice 1 on Friday November 20.
Hamilton shares details of meeting children from Gaza
A day after his initial post, Hamilton took to social media again on Thursday to share details of his interactions with children he met who have been evacuated from Gaza.

Along with sharing a selection of photos of himself with the children, Hamilton wrote: "Meeting some of the Palestinian children evacuated from Gaza and supported by @inaraorg in Egypt broke my heart.

"Beautiful, bright children who have faced trauma, grief and horrendous injuries, things no child should ever have to endure. Some have been shot or badly burned in attacks and are still facing a complicated road towards recovery. But what really struck me was how resilient they were and how much joy they seem to find in each other.

"When I asked about their dreams, they spoke about becoming teachers and doctors so they could help others, the way they were helped. After everything they've been through, they still imagine a future caring for other people. That has stayed with me.

"I met children at school, in hospital and at a mental health clinic helping them work through their trauma. I also went into families' homes and listened to their stories of recovery and being separated from loved ones - their children, their parents, their siblings. The pain of that separation and uncertainty is hard to comprehend.

"Their stories made me think about the children still in Gaza, who are living in terrible conditions. According to reports, more than 21,500 children have been killed and 45,000 injured since October 2023. Every one of them had a home and a future. We can't forget them.

"These children are no different from yours. Their lives are just as precious. They should be able to feel safe in a classroom with friends, be with their families and imagine a future. I'm so grateful the young people I met are getting the help they need, but it's heartbreaking that they've had to leave their homes to find safety."
Gaza health authorities say more than 74,000 people have been killed since Israel began its Gaza assault in October 2023.
Israel launched the offensive after Hamas gunmen led an attack on southern Israel, which it said killed around 1,200.
